Mathlib.Order.Defs

Statements of Mathlib (commit 6972d52c0d), each with its Lean source, its translation to Dedukti by Export.lean, and its informalization by Informath, in English, as a formula, and in French, Czech, German and Swedish, which the buttons at each entry show there, and the check boxes above the entries everywhere. The Dedukti translation drops implicit and instance arguments and maps Lean's arithmetic and logic to Informath's base (mapping.tsv); the other Mathlib constants are worded by the symbol table mathlib.dkgf, whose English wordings Informath also renders in the other languages. Constants without a wording appear as $\mathrm{name}$.

theorem Pi.le_def {ι : Type*} {π : ι → Type*} [∀ i, LE (π i)] {x y : ∀ i, π i} :
    x ≤ y ↔ ∀ i, x i ≤ y i :=
  .rfl
Dedukti
2 lines
def Pi__le_def : (I : Set) -> (x : (Elem I -> Set)) -> (_ : Proof ((i3 : Elem I) -> LE (x i3))) -> (x2 : ((i2 : Elem I) -> x i2)) -> (y : ((i1 : Elem I) -> x i1)) -> Proof (iff (Leq x2 y) (forall I (i => Leq (x2 i) (y i)))) :=
  I => x => x1 => x2 => y => Iff__rfl (Leq x2 y).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $x$ be a function from elements of $I$ to sets such that for all elements $i_{3}$ of $I$, $x (i_{3})$ is ordered. Let $x_{2}$ be a function from elements $i_{2}$ of $I$ to elements of $x (i_{2})$. Let $y$ be a function from elements $i_{1}$ of $I$ to elements of $x (i_{1})$. Then $x_{2} \leq y$, if and only if for all elements $i$ of $I$, $x_{2} (i)\leq y (i)$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $x$ une fonction des éléments de $I$ à des ensembles telle que pour tous les éléments $i_{3}$ de $I$, $x (i_{3})$ soit ordonné. Soit $x_{2}$ une fonction des éléments $i_{2}$ de $I$ à des éléments de $x (i_{2})$. Soit $y$ une fonction des éléments $i_{1}$ de $I$ à des éléments de $x (i_{1})$. Alors $x_{2} \leq y$ si et seulement si pour tous les éléments $i$ de $I$, $x_{2} (i)\leq y (i)$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $x$ je funkce z prvků z $I$ do množin taková, že pro všechny prvky $i_{3}$ z $I$, $x (i_{3})$ je uspořádané. Nechť $x_{2}$ je funkce z prvků $i_{2}$ z $I$ do prvků z $x (i_{2})$. Nechť $y$ je funkce z prvků $i_{1}$ z $I$ do prvků z $x (i_{1})$. Tedy $x_{2} \leq y$, právě tehdy, když pro všechny prvky $i$ z $I$, $x_{2} (i)\leq y (i)$.
Formula
$I \in \mathrm{Set} , x \in I \rightarrow \mathrm{Set} , \forall i_{3} \in I . \mathrm{LE} (x (i_{3})), x_{2} \in I \rightarrow x (i_{2}), y \in I \rightarrow x (i_{1})\vdash x_{2} \leq y \leftrightarrow (\forall i \in I . x_{2} (i)\leq y (i))$

English
Let $X$ be a set. Let $r$ be a function from elements of $X$ and elements of $X$ to propositions such that for all elements $a$, $b$ and $c$ of $X$, if $r (a , b)$, then if $r (b , c)$, then $r (a , c)$. Then $r$ is transitive.
French
Soit $X$ un ensemble. Soit $r$ une fonction des éléments de $X$ et des éléments de $X$ à des propositions telle que pour tous les éléments $a$, $b$ et $c$ de $X$, si $r (a , b)$, alors si $r (b , c)$, alors $r (a , c)$. Alors $r$ est transitif.
Czech
Nechť $X$ je množina. Nechť $r$ je funkce z prvků z $X$ a prvků z $X$ do výroků taková, že pro všechny prvky $a$, $b$ a $c$ z $X$, jestliže $r (a , b)$, pak jestliže $r (b , c)$, pak $r (a , c)$. Tedy $r$ je tranzitivní.
Formula
$X \in \mathrm{Set} , r \in X \rightarrow X \rightarrow \mathrm{Prop} , \forall a \in X . \forall b \in X . \forall c \in X . r (a , b)\rightarrow r (b , c)\rightarrow r (a , c)\vdash \mathrm{IsTrans} (X , r)$

Lean
@[to_dual /-- A lower set relative to a predicate `P` is a set such that all elements satisfy `P`
and any element less than one of its members and satisfying `P` is also a member. -/]
def IsRelUpperSet {α : Type*} [LE α] (s : Set α) (P : α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃a : α⦄, a ∈ s → P a ∧ ∀ ⦃b : α⦄, a ≤ b → P b → b ∈ s
Dedukti
2 lines
def IsRelUpperSet : (X : Set) -> (s : Elem (powerset X)) -> (P : (Elem X -> Prop)) -> Prop :=
  X => s => P => forall X (a => if (Membership__mem X (powerset X) s a) (and (P a) (forall X (b => if (Leq a b) (if (P b) (Membership__mem X (powerset X) s b)))))).
English
Let $X$ be a set. Let $s \in \wp X$. Let $P$ be a function from elements of $X$ to propositions. Then $X$ is a relative upper set with respect to $s$, if for all elements $a$ of $X$, if $a$ is an element of $s$, then $P (a)$ and for all elements $b$ of $X$, if $a \leq b$, then if $P (b)$, then $b$ is an element of $s$.
French
Soit $X$ un ensemble. Soit $s \in \wp X$. Soit $P$ une fonction des éléments de $X$ à des propositions. Alors $X$ est un ensemble supérieur relatif par rapport à $s$ si pour tous les éléments $a$ de $X$, si $a$ est un élément de $s$, alors $P (a)$ et pour tous les éléments $b$ de $X$, si $a \leq b$, alors si $P (b)$, alors $b$ est un élément de $s$.
Czech
Nechť $X$ je množina. Nechť $s \in \wp X$. Nechť $P$ je funkce z prvků z $X$ do výroků. Tedy $X$ je relativní horní množina vzhledem k $s$, jestliže pro všechny prvky $a$ z $X$, jestliže $a$ je element $s$, pak $P (a)$ a pro všechny prvky $b$ z $X$, jestliže $a \leq b$, pak jestliže $P (b)$, pak $b$ je element $s$.
Formula
$X \in \mathrm{Set} , s \in \wp X , P \in X \rightarrow \mathrm{Prop} \vdash \mathrm{IsRelUpperSet} (X , s , P):\Leftrightarrow \forall a \in X . \MembershipmemMACRoDX {s}{a}\rightarrow P (a)\wedge (\forall b \in X . a \leq b \rightarrow P (b)\rightarrow \MembershipmemMACRoDX {s}{b})$

A preorder is a reflexive, transitive relation ≤. In a preorder, a < b means a ≤ b ∧ ¬b ≤ a, and < is defined this way by default. You can override this definition to set a better def-eq.

tacticCompareOfLessAndEq_rfldefLinearOrder.lean:53
This attempts to prove that a given instance of compare is equal to compareOfLessAndEq by introducing the arguments and trying the following approaches in order:
1. seeing if rfl works 2. seeing if the compare at hand is nonetheless essentially compareOfLessAndEq, but, because of implicit arguments, requires us to unfold the defs and split the ifs in the definition of compareOfLessAndEq 3. seeing if we can split by cases on the arguments, then see if the defs work themselves out (useful when compare is defined via a match statement, as it is for Bool)
Lean
macro "compareOfLessAndEq_rfl" : tactic =>
  `(tactic| (intro a b; first | rfl |
    (simp only [compare, compareOfLessAndEq]; split_ifs <;> rfl) |
    (induction a <;> induction b <;> simp +decide only)))

Soit $\mathrm{sup}$ une fonction des éléments de $X$ et des éléments de $X$ à des éléments de $X$ telle que pour tous les éléments $a_{2}$ et $b_{2}$ de $X$, $a_{2} \leq \mathrm{sup} (a_{2} , b_{2})$, pour tous les éléments $a_{1}$ et $b_{1}$ de $X$, $b_{1} \leq \mathrm{sup} (a_{1} , b_{1})$ et pour tous les éléments $a$, $b$ et $c$ de $X$, si $a \leq c$, alors si $b \leq c$, alors $\mathrm{sup} (a , b)\leq c$. DistribLatticeinductiveLattice.lean:294
A distributive lattice is a lattice that satisfies any of four equivalent distributive properties (of sup over inf or inf over sup, on the left or right).
The definition here chooses le_sup_inf: (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ≤ x ⊔ (y ⊓ z). To prove distributivity from the dual law, use DistribLattice.ofInfSupLe.
A classic example of a distributive lattice is the lattice of subsets of a set, and in fact this example is generic in the sense that every distributive lattice is realizable as a sublattice of a powerset lattice.

@[to_dual existing mk]
abbrev DistribLattice.ofInfSupLe
    [Lattice α] (inf_sup_le : ∀ a b c : α, a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ≤ a ⊓ b ⊔ a ⊓ c) : DistribLattice α where

1 lines
DistribLattice__ofInfSupLe : (X : Set) -> (inf_sup_le : Proof (forall X (a => forall X (b => forall X (c => Leq (Min__min X a (Max__max X b c)) (Max__max X (Min__min X a b) (Min__min X a c))))))) -> Elem (DistribLattice__on X).
English
Let $X$ be a set such that for all elements $a$, $b$ and $c$ of $X$, $\MinminMACRoED {a}{(\MaxmaxMACRoEC {b}{c})}\leq \MaxmaxMACRoEC {(\MinminMACRoED {a}{b})}{(\MinminMACRoED {a}{c})}$. Then $\operatorname{ofInfSupLe} (X , \mathrm{inf\_sup\_le})$ is a distributive lattice structure on $X$.
French
Soit $X$ un ensemble tel que pour tous les éléments $a$, $b$ et $c$ de $X$, $\MinminMACRoED {a}{(\MaxmaxMACRoEC {b}{c})}\leq \MaxmaxMACRoEC {(\MinminMACRoED {a}{b})}{(\MinminMACRoED {a}{c})}$. Alors $\operatorname{ofInfSupLe} (X , \mathrm{inf\_sup\_le})$ est une structure de treillis distributive sur $X$.
Czech
Nechť $X$ je množina taková, že pro všechny prvky $a$, $b$ a $c$ z $X$, minimum $a$ a maxima $b$ a $c$ je menší nebo rovné než maximum minima $a$ a $b$ a minima $a$ a $c$. Tedy $\operatorname{ofInfSupLe} (X , \mathrm{inf\_sup\_le})$ je distributivní struktura svazu na $X$.
Formula
$X \in \mathrm{Set} , \forall a \in X . \forall b \in X . \forall c \in X . \MinminMACRoEK {a}{(\MaxmaxMACRoEJ {b}{c})}\leq \MaxmaxMACRoEJ {(\MinminMACRoEK {a}{b})}{(\MinminMACRoEK {a}{c})}\vdash \operatorname{ofInfSupLe} (X , \mathrm{inf\_sup\_le})\in \operatorname{on} (X)$

inf_sup_lefttheoremLattice.lean:323
Lean
@[to_dual existing]
theorem inf_sup_left (a b c : α) : a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) = a ⊓ b ⊔ a ⊓ c :=
  calc
    a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) = a ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) := by rw [inf_sup_self]
    _ = a ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by simp only [inf_assoc, sup_inf_right]
    _ = (a ⊔ a ⊓ b) ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by rw [sup_inf_self]
    _ = (a ⊓ b ⊔ a) ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by rw [sup_comm]
    _ = a ⊓ b ⊔ a ⊓ c := by rw [sup_inf_left]
